name: Haran
brief: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.
short: Haran was a city in Mesopotamia where Abraham and his family settled after leaving Ur, and from where Abraham later departed for Canaan (<ref="Genesis 11:31-32; 12:4-5; 27:43; 28:10; 29:4; Act.7.2, 4">Genesis 11:31-32; 12:4-5; 27:43; 28:10; 29:4; Act.7.2, 4</ref>).
